title: Charge or Block Positioning
description: A help defender practises getting legally set with both feet before a drive arrives, learning the footwork and timing that separates a charge from a foul.

content.objective: Get legally positioned with both feet set before contact, understanding what makes position legal.
content.setup: A driver attacks the rim as a help defender steps into the driving lane.
instructions: The help defender steps into the path and gets both feet planted before the driver arrives.
The driver attacks at a controlled, game-realistic pace, not full-contact speed.
The group discusses together whether the position was legal and early enough.
Repeat with the defender arriving late to show the contrast.
coachingPoints: Get both feet set and stationary well before contact.
Keep the arms up and in rather than extended into the driver.
Take the contact with the torso, not by leaning in.
commonMistakes: Still moving sideways at the moment of contact.
Leaning into the driver instead of absorbing contact standing still.
Reaching with the hands instead of moving the feet.
content.safety: Run this drill at a controlled pace with light, safe contact only; stop immediately if contact becomes too forceful.
